metadata.name: laserfont2
metadata.status: Geometry verified; CAM and machine qualification pending
metadata.intent: Reduce disconnected cutting paths and pierces, retain legibility, then soften turns.
metadata.curves: Cubic Beziers; tangent G1 joins where joined; not universal G2 curvature continuity.
metadata.exceptions: Intentional T or tangential junctions remain in several glyphs; X central crossover is interrupted. No duplicate strokes or intended closed cut loops.

A.design_note: Two counter bridges; crown is separated from a rounded feet/crossbar path.

B.design_note: Four paths and one shared waist bar. Two independent 3 mm bridge gaps per bowl; inner gaps meet the bar endpoint from opposite sides.

I.design_note: Top and bottom bars distinguish I from numeral 1.

K.design_note: Two paths, curved diagonal waist touches upright tangentially.

Q.design_note: External Q tail begins exactly on bowl, not across it; no recut intersection.

R.design_note: Diagonal leg distinguishes R; three cut paths, two counter gaps.

X.design_note: Three paths avoid recutting the central intersection; one diagonal has a 3 mm center gap, not an enclosed counter.

0.design_note: Narrow oval and isolated interior slash distinguish zero from O.

4.design_note: Open top and interrupted crossbar provide two counter openings.

8.design_note: Three paths form a smaller upper cap, larger lower bowl and diagonal waist. Two clear bridge gaps per counter, each at least 3 mm.
